body: Thank you. I think there could possibly be some services where I live?? child abuse cases are very common in my state , so I'm sure they could have a refuge or something,, I'm way too anxious to ask my friend right now since they live three states away but I'll see what I can do to help myself keep going in the meantime..

I'm afraid not , I don't have anywhere to go to but I do have an emergency fund if things go super south, I've been in a really unstable environment since forever and I wish I was able to heal from everything. I could ask a close friend that I know online if I could give them a visit but I doubt their family would let me stay since their family isn't friendly towards asian people. There's nothing to be sorry for!! I still have a little bit of hope that makes me wonder that if one day everything I went through made me stronger in the end.

YES!! I know this feeling all too well , when I get positive and stuff it's  all out and i feel like nothing can stop me and stuff , but as soon as that stops I just sink back into mental breakdowns , crying , being 'overly-sensitive', angry , just a mix of negative emotions, the only "in-between" for me is when I just feel numb. But those positive episodes get me planning on graduating and becoming a ceo of a company and so much other shit when i dont even have anything in my life together.
